description: This file contains Redux action creators for user-related operations in a Mattermost application, including user management, status updates, profile handling, session management, and access tokens.

methods.name: generateMfaSecret
methods.description: Generates MFA secret for a user via Client4 API.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user and dispatches relevant Redux actions.

methods.name: loadMe
methods.description: Loads current user data and related configurations.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Performs user logout and dispatches Redux actions.

methods.name: getTotalUsersStats
methods.description: Fetches total user statistics from server.

methods.name: getFilteredUsersStats
methods.description: Fetches filtered user statistics based on options.

methods.name: getProfiles
methods.description: Retrieves user profiles with pagination.

methods.name: getMissingProfilesByIds
methods.description: Fetches missing user profiles by IDs, batching requests.

methods.name: getMissingProfilesByUsernames
methods.description: Fetches missing user profiles by usernames, batching requests.

methods.name: getProfilesByIds
methods.description: Fetches user profiles by IDs.

methods.name: getProfilesByUsernames
methods.description: Fetches user profiles by usernames.

methods.name: getProfilesInTeam
methods.description: Retrieves profiles in a specific team.

methods.name: getProfilesNotInTeam
methods.description: Retrieves profiles not in a specific team.

methods.name: getProfilesInChannel
methods.description: Retrieves profiles in a specific channel.

methods.name: batchGetProfilesInChannel
methods.description: Batches requests to get profiles in a channel.

methods.name: getProfilesInGroupChannels
methods.description: Retrieves profiles in multiple group channels.

methods.name: getProfilesNotInChannel
methods.description: Retrieves profiles not in a specific channel.

methods.name: getMe
methods.description: Fetches current user's profile.

methods.name: getCustomProfileAttributeValues
methods.description: Fetches custom profile attribute values for a user.

methods.name: updateMyTermsOfServiceStatus
methods.description: Updates current user's Terms of Service acceptance status.

methods.name: getProfilesInGroup
methods.description: Retrieves profiles in a group.

methods.name: getProfilesNotInGroup
methods.description: Retrieves profiles not in a group.

methods.name: getTermsOfService
methods.description: Fetches Terms of Service from server.

methods.name: promoteGuestToUser
methods.description: Promotes a guest user to a regular user.

methods.name: demoteUserToGuest
methods.description: Demotes a user to guest status.

methods.name: createTermsOfService
methods.description: Creates new Terms of Service.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Fetches a user profile by ID.

methods.name: getUserByUsername
methods.description: Fetches a user profile by username.

methods.name: getUserByEmail
methods.description: Fetches a user profile by email.

methods.name: canUserDirectMessage
methods.description: Checks if a user can direct message another user.

methods.name: getStatusesByIds
methods.description: Fetches statuses for multiple users.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of the current user.

methods.name: setCustomStatus
methods.description: Sets a custom status for the user.

methods.name: unsetCustomStatus
methods.description: Unsets the custom status.

methods.name: removeRecentCustomStatus
methods.description: Removes a recent custom status.

methods.name: getSessions
methods.description: Retrieves user sessions.

methods.name: revokeSession
methods.description: Revokes a specific user session.

methods.name: revokeAllSessionsForUser
methods.description: Revokes all sessions for a user.

methods.name: revokeSessionsForAllUsers
methods.description: Revokes all sessions for all users.

methods.name: getUserAudits
methods.description: Fetches audit logs for a user.

methods.name: autocompleteUsers
methods.description: Performs user autocomplete search.

methods.name: searchProfiles
methods.description: Searches user profiles based on a term.

methods.name: updateMe
methods.description: Updates current user's profile.

methods.name: saveCustomProfileAttribute
methods.description: Saves a custom profile attribute for a user.

methods.name: patchUser
methods.description: Updates user profile.

methods.name: updateUserAuth
methods.description: Updates user's authentication data.

methods.name: updateUserRoles
methods.description: Updates user's roles.

methods.name: updateUserMfa
methods.description: Updates user's MFA status.

methods.name: updateUserPassword
methods.description: Changes user's password.

methods.name: resetFailedAttempts
methods.description: Resets failed login attempts for a user.

methods.name: updateUserActive
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a user.

methods.name: verifyUserEmail
methods.description: Verifies user's email with a token.

methods.name: sendVerificationEmail
methods.description: Sends email verification.

methods.name: resetUserPassword
methods.description: Resets user's password with a token.

methods.name: sendPasswordResetEmail
methods.description: Sends password reset email.

methods.name: setDefaultProfileImage
methods.description: Resets user's profile image to default.

methods.name: uploadProfileImage
methods.description: Uploads a new profile image for user.

methods.name: switchEmailToOAuth
methods.description: Switches email login to OAuth.

methods.name: switchOAuthToEmail
methods.description: Switches OAuth login to email.

methods.name: switchEmailToLdap
methods.description: Switches email login to LDAP.

methods.name: switchLdapToEmail
methods.description: Switches LDAP login to email.

methods.name: createUserAccessToken
methods.description: Creates a new user access token.

methods.name: getUserAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves a specific user access token.

methods.name: getUserAccessTokensForUser
methods.description: Retrieves all access tokens for a user.

methods.name: revokeUserAccessToken
methods.description: Revokes a specific access token.

methods.name: disableUserAccessToken
methods.description: Disables a token.

methods.name: enableUserAccessToken
methods.description: Enables a token.

methods.name: getKnownUsers
methods.description: Retrieves known users list.

methods.name: clearUserAccessTokens
methods.description: Clears current user's access tokens.

methods.name: checkForModifiedUsers
methods.description: Checks for user modifications since last disconnect.
